themes.theme: Scope and Application of the Ban
themes.reason: Defines exactly which vessels and waters the ban covers and justifies exclusions (e.g. foreign vessels), which is central to what is actually being implemented and why; without this the implementation proposal has no defined boundaries.

Explains the chosen method for delivering the intervention (amending existing SI rather than creating a new one) and the reasoning for this choice, directly addressing why this method was chosen over alternatives.

Provides the detailed cost estimates and assumptions for enforcement, which is a should-explain point about costs and benefits, but the core implementation case (what method, why, and scope) could still stand without these specific figures.
Describes procedural next steps and evidence-gathering plans, which support refining the policy but are not themselves the basis for why this implementation method was chosen.
